authorization: User-authorized post-chain scientific sequence and quantitative freeze. Root reviews and commits exact source/config identities before arming. Default static validation does not authorize execution.
completion_gate: Exact registered terminal chain plus original lease absent; exact original owner proven ended is an additional driver-log race guard. Neither PID ending nor process-name matching proves completion. Strict original export_main_context succeeds and binds this exact chain before any NEW scientific source integration.
prospective_documents: All governing prospective registrations, operational amendment and reviewed documentation are finalized and committed in main before arming and before strict export. Do not change governing bytes after dependency export.
integration: Root-supplied reviewed full commit/source_path/blob/Git mode/SHA256/destination entries. Add only absent, untracked, non-original regular paths. No replacement of original scientific source, binary, data, model, calibration or reference bytes. Bootstrap controls live outside original scientific roots. Freeze an additive source-extension manifest and commit it before G0.
tests: Pre-G0 focused tests are pure metadata/fake-fixture gate/product/P73/surrogate/freeze/bootstrap controls; no oracle/Cantera/core/MLX/label acquisition. G0 is the first new numerical action. Surrogate manufactured controls follow fresh committed G0 and P73. Nozzle source controls follow authenticated committed surrogate artifacts. Final product verification runs the exact registered seven files, no case filtering/skips, with independent all-cases JUnit PASS plus exact raw pytest log and waited-child proof. No extra simulator acquisition or sealed-label reads.
ownership: Bootstrap has its own fresh output directory and lite owner lease. Every test suite holds the shared scientific owner lease; test fixtures must authenticate exact recorded child PID/birth against that lease. Consumer studies own and release their own shared lease. Unknown child ending, live child or unresolved scientific lease retains bootstrap ownership. No stale-lease deletion, retry, original process signal or automatic recovery.
launch: caffeinate -i nice -n15 wraps bootstrap once. Each child retains nice>=15, single library threads, AC and unchanged scientific/config/ownership identities immediately before GO, then same-PID exec of the pinned actual interpreter. Persist owner PID/birth, raw committed config/driver hashes, command spec/handshake/native launcher command/GO/raw log/actual waited exit. Target launch failure never becomes scientific completion.
dependencies: Only root-config-authorized missing pins scipy==1.16.3, PyYAML==6.0.3, Cantera==3.2.0, pandas==2.3.3, python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0, pytz==2025.2, tzdata==2025.2, six==1.17.0, ruamel.yaml==0.18.16, ruamel.yaml.clib==0.2.15 in the exact hashed MLX interpreter may be installed post-release/export, using explicit pip --no-deps and metadata-only before/after probes. Existing numpy/typing_extensions/MLX/Torch/pytest remain unchanged. Existing mismatched versions block; no mutable requirements inference or existing environment overwrite.
commits: Before every selective commit or tag, prove no Git process, worktree/common index lock or merge conflict. Never remove a lock. Commit only explicit owned paths; preserve unrelated staged/dirty files. Check terminal/reservation/released joins, actual exits, hash/coverage/source integrity before artifact commits; then independently validate committed producer proof.
scientific_fail: Only authenticated fully computed scientific FAIL with execution_complete true, actual nonzero exit, scientific_verdict FAIL, exact coverage and no errors/drift/provenance failure may continue to source-property/nozzle/quantitative freeze consumption. Never authorize deployment or another held-out score. ERROR/partial or failed source/prerequisite gates stop the driver.
usage: After exact final product tests, install only root-reviewed conditional README usage/limitations bytes, preserving original scientific bytes. No scientific results prose.
freeze: Only published quantitative artifacts through registered freeze utility. Verify exact committed sources, producer completion, eight figure pairs, quantitative table and final test receipt. Commit raw bootstrap evidence before tag. Only armed root-authorized local freeze-2026-10-18 tag; never move an existing tag, push or promote scientific FAIL.
static_checks: Parse new Python AST and JSON, review source, git diff --check. Pure stdlib bootstrap fixture tests are isolated operational checks; no numerical execution or scientific imports during drafting.
rollback: An interrupted or blocked driver preserves evidence and unresolved ownership. Root reviews exact terminal/raw records before a separately registered recovery; no automatic retry or cleanup. Prospective additive changes can be reverted with new commits; history remains intact.
